gloss: Gilead, the hill country east of the Jordan
summary: Jacob crosses the river toward the hills of Gilead. The name belongs both to this territory and to families associated with it.

senses.definition: Part of the land east of the Jordan bears this name. In the psalm God lays claim to Gilead and Manasseh.
The term names the clan descended from Gilead and people of his region, including Jephthah.

note: Genesis 31:47–48 explains the heap called Galeed, entered in galal. The similar name of the region occurs earlier in the narrative. Its derivation remains uncertain.
